translation_notes: `self.edm[ids].graph.value(subject=self.cho[ids], predicate=URIRef('http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/language'))` -> `m{ {self.cho[ids]} dc:language ?v }.first()` under `@graph self.edm[ids].graph`: the keyword arguments of `value()` become the pattern, the `URIRef('...')` becomes a prefixed name. The `Literal('en')` of the expected side is untouched.

Test harness restored (kind=function, unittest.TestCase method that only asserts): driver.py supplies a real unittest.TestCase carrying what the real class's setUp binds (`edm[ids].graph`, `cho[ids]`); `demo(self)` (identical on both sides, appended to original.py and translated.ldpy) returns 'ok' or ('assertion-failed', message). The message of assertEqual contains the value that was read, so a wrong read is visible, not just a failed test.

Fixture and calls (12): 'en' present with neighbours (another record with 'fr', dcterms:language and ex:language on the same subject, a record with only dcterms:language) -> ok; 'fr'; no dc:language (None); two values in both orders (first read wins); "en"@en and "en"^^xsd:string (neither equals Literal('en')); an IRI value; self.cho mapped to other objects; ids missing from self.edm (KeyError compared as a raise); empty graph. Mutations: dc:language -> dc:title, and the subject `{self.cho[ids]}` -> `?s`, both FAIL; restored.
optimization_notes: optimized.py: value()'s keyword arguments subject=/predicate= become positional (4 tokens). Nothing else to compress: the test asserts a single read. The demo() harness is copied as is.

optimized.ldpy has no island: its region is optimized.py's. `@graph self.edm[ids].graph` + `m{ {self.cho[ids]} dc:language ?v }.first()` (translated.ldpy's form) costs exactly as many tokens as the positional value() call, and it needs `@prefix dc:` in the header where the Python form needs URIRef. The form with no island is therefore never longer, so it is the one kept (rule 4).
No exception to the symmetry. The notation ratio (1.102) is the cost of translated.ldpy's unused `@prefix dc:` header line alone.
`@prefix` is declared only because translated.ldpy's header line `@prefix dc:` is kept byte for byte in optimized.ldpy; no island uses it.
header_optimization_notes: Python: nothing is unused (Literal and URIRef are both read); optimized_header.py is a copy of optimized.py.
LD Python: the `@prefix dc:` line is unused and goes; optimized_header.ldpy is identical to optimized_header.py.
